chapter: Shows, scripts and the Mosby-era names
title: Charlie Lawrence, Lloyd Reese, Howard Patrick and the Sunnyland band
summary: More names from McCarthy's book, including the Sunnyland personnel with Clarence Williams, Buster Wilson and Ben Borders, much of whom went to Mosby.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: Yeah, Charlie Lawrence lives out here on, I think, a coupla three, four blocks past Crenshaw, one of those streets out there.
I remember the street but I can't think... I called him up about a year or so ago and talked to him. He's crazy about photography now.
Yeah. He was a saxophone player.
Uh, this was in Paul Howard's band at the New Cotton Club.
Yeah, Foresythe. I remember that name but I don't remember him personally. I would if I'd see him, I guess.
He worked in your band, right?
No, he played with the Sunnyland. But he, you know, he play with anybody.
Oh, yeah, here's the Sunnyland personnel: Clarence Williams, string bass; Charlie Lawrence, alto sax...

Clarence Williams is the bass player was on that So Different Orchestra. You know, the big picture I showed you? And then after we...we broke up 'n' I went in the music business and ever'thing, Clarence Williams started with the Sunnyland.
And Buster Wilson, piano; Jesse Smith, tenor sax; Ben Borders, drums; Howard Patrick, banjo; James Porter, trumpet, and Ashford Hardie, trombone.
Yeah. Most of that band was Mosby's band after ...Hardie and Porter and all of them went to Mosby when he had the Blue Blowers.
